notes.title: Simplified Chinese added
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42945068/abdd3fd696c3f2bf87906fc155cdd988234c0156.png"][/img][/p][p]Language support has finally been added, along with a few minor updates and fixes.[/p][list][*][p]Simplified Chinese can now be selected as a language option.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the Unity engine (no more splash screen).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug on the info panel's scrollbar.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor text edits.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Small save update
notes.content: When closing the game without following the menus, an autosave will be created. When resuming the game, the autosave will be loaded by default. For those who have been relying on save scumming, it's recommended to use the loading screen instead of the resume button.
